# cjw_multisite

`cjw_multisite` is the second multisite package in the package index of Exponential 6.0.15, next to the default
[sevenx_multisite](../sevenx-multisite/README.md). It installs the **CJW starter site**: a site drawn by the design
`starter` of the [CJW Themes Jumper](the-cjw-themes-jumper-extension.md) extension, with its starter content in
German and English, its layouts, and the usual administration siteaccesses.

This page is for administrators who want to install it, hosts who offer it as a choice, and developers or designers
who want to know how a site package built around a theme extension works. It gives the overview; the pages listed
under [The pages of this part](#the-pages-of-this-part) go into each piece.

## What cjw_multisite is

The package index of 6.0.15 describes it this way (the `description` attribute of its entry in
[index.xml](https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15/index.xml)):

```text
CJW Multisite is the starter site of the CJW Themes Jumper design (design starter) for Exponential:
an English and a German site with the starter content and its layouts, and the administration.
```

| Fact | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Package name | `cjw_multisite` | `package.xml` `<name>` |
| Summary | CJW Multisite | `package.xml` `<summary>` |
| Type | `site` | `<type value="site" />` |
| Vendor | `7x` | `<vendor>` |
| Version | `6.0.15-0` (number `6.0`, release `15-stable`) | `package` attribute `version` and `<version>` |
| Install type | `import` | `install_type="import"` |
| License | GPL (`<licence>GPL</licence>`, with `documents/LICENCE`) | `package.xml` |
| Archive | `cjw_multisite.ezpkg`, 97,634 bytes on the package server | `content-length` of the download |
| Default site title | CJW JAC Exponential | `initSettings()` of the installer |

The site package itself carries no content: like every site package it names the packages it needs and brings the
install scripts that build the siteaccesses and settings around them. See
[What it is made of](what-it-is-made-of.md).

## The three things it needs

| Needed | What it brings | Where it comes from |
|---|---|---|
| `sevenx_classes` | The base content classes (`<require type="ezpackage" name="sevenx_classes" min-version="5.1" />`) | The package server, the same package `sevenx_multisite` uses |
| `cjw_multisite_democontent` | The starter content, 40 content classes, and the layouts, tags and URL paths as JSON and XML side files | The package server; see [The demo content package](the-demo-content-package.md) |
| The extension `cjw_themes_jumper` | The design `starter` and the **images and files** of the starter content (`share/content-images`, `share/content-files`) | `extension/cjw_themes_jumper`; the root `composer.json` of Exponential 6.0.15 requires `se7enxweb/cjw_themes_jumper` `~0.1.6` |

> **Warning**
> The images and files of the starter content are not in any package. The installer links them into the content
> package from `extension/cjw_themes_jumper/share/` for the time of the install. Without the extension in
> `extension/`, the install logs the missing files and the site has no design. See
> [The CJW Themes Jumper extension](the-cjw-themes-jumper-extension.md).

## Installing it

`cjw_multisite` installs like any site package: choose it in the [setup wizard](../../../install/05-setup-wizard.md),
name it as `Site_package` in `kickstart.ini` for the [kickstarter](../../../install/06-kickstarter.md), or pass it to
the [console install](../../../install/07-console-install.md). The package's own description gives this command:

```bash
./console exp:install --package=cjw_multisite --languages=eng-US,ger-DE
```

The same description adds "choose German too, most of the starter content is German". Of the 137 starter objects
listed in `cjw-starter-import.json`, 111 are in `ger-DE` only, 22 in `eng-US` only and 4 in both. The 6.0.15
changelog records that an install with `eng-US` alone used to log 125 errors and could not show that content; the
kernel now adds the content's language as a fallback language (`eZStepCreateSites::contentFallbackLanguages()`).
Still, a German siteaccess is what makes the starter site complete. See
[Siteaccesses and languages](siteaccesses-and-languages.md).

For the kickstarter, the equivalent part of `kickstart.ini`:

```ini
[language_options]
Continue=true
Primary=eng-US
Languages[]=ger-DE

[site_types]
Continue=true
Site_package=cjw_multisite
```

## Where it comes from

| Place | What is there |
|---|---|
| [se7enxweb/cjw_multisite-ezpackage](https://github.com/se7enxweb/cjw_multisite-ezpackage) | The source: `packages/cjw_multisite/`, `packages/cjw_multisite_democontent/`, and `bin/pack.sh`, which packs each folder into its `.ezpkg` |
| [The package server, 6.0.15](https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15/index.xml) | [cjw_multisite.ezpkg](https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15/cjw_multisite.ezpkg), [cjw_multisite_democontent.ezpkg](https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15/cjw_multisite_democontent.ezpkg) and the [thumbnail](https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15/thumbnails/cjw_multisite.png) |
| [se7enxweb/cjw_themes_jumper](https://github.com/se7enxweb/cjw_themes_jumper) | The design and the content's images and files |
| `var/storage/packages/7x/cjw_multisite` and `.../cjw_multisite_democontent` | The imported copies in an installation |

The source repository was created on 2026-10-07 ("Added: The source repository of the CJW Multisite installation
packages, laid out as the 7x package repository, ..."), and the two packages reached the package server the same day.
Up to 2026-10-16 the repository has 16 commits; the later ones change the installer (expqueue and expai, ezoracle,
ezurlmultisite, the interface choices of the editor, exp_adminui, ezownerchange).

A running copy of the starter site is listed on [Demo sites](../../designers/distribution/demo-sites.md):
[site.cjw.demo.exponential.earth](https://site.cjw.demo.exponential.earth/).
